ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_preference_signal_loss_weighted_logsigmoid_with_delta_rank
ir.intuition: Repaired failure by removing the missing 'cost_gap' key dependency and instead using 'delta_rank' as the quality signal to ensure the loss is sensitive to objective differences. The loss now computes logsigmoid of weight times the difference of log probabilities scaled multiplicatively by (1 + alpha * delta_rank). This maintains dynamic modulation of the margin while using an available key, passing the ObjectiveSensitivity gate and eliminating missing key errors.
ir.pseudocode:
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scaled_obj = 1 + alpha * delta_rank
margin = weight * diff * scaled_obj
preference_score = logsigmoid(margin)
loss = -preference_score
return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    alpha = float(extra.get("alpha", 1.0))
    log_prob_w = batch["log_prob_w"]
    log_prob_l = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    delta_rank = batch["delta_rank"]
    diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
    scaled_obj = ops.add(ops.ones_like(delta_rank), ops.mul(alpha, delta_rank))
    margin = ops.mul(weight, ops.mul(diff, scaled_obj))
    preference = ops.logsigmoid(margin)
    loss = ops.neg(preference)
    return ops.mean(loss)
